clips.title: The story
paras: Asterion seeks release from his prison among the ruined pillars of Bashal'Aran. He has traced the binding magic to the satyrs who command the grells and asks travelers to recover the Ancient Moonstone Seal.

For more than a thousand years, Asterion has remained bound to the ruins of Bashal'Aran. The marble pillars around him mark the limits of his prison, beyond the reach of his fading strength and ancient magic. A cursed relic holds him here. Through the centuries, he has watched Darkshore's canopy and wondered whether the wearing stone could ever set him free.

Nearby grells carried traces of the magic that binds Asterion, and he deduced that the Ancient Moonstone Seal was the source of the enchantment. The satyrs who command the grells now hold the seal. These demonic night elves wander the ancient groves, keeping watch over the relic. Asterion needs the seal recovered before its binding power can be broken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

I feel strongly that this must be true, friend. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It... It is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, friend. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
